messages:
maria: Heads-up — I rebased feature/authz onto main and pushed earlier. CI is red on our integration suite. Can someone help triage? https://ci.internal/runs/12345

maria: Failing tests: tests/integration/test_session_flow.py::test_token_exchange and a token refresh test. Here's the core of the failure from the job log:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 200 but got 500
E   File "auth/middleware.py", line 142, in validate_headers
E     token = headers['authorization']
KeyError: 'authorization'
```

maria: @samir any idea? I didn't touch middleware except for a tiny normalization change.

samir: On it. Can you confirm if rerunning the job changed anything?

ci-bot: Re-triggered build 12346 (manual rerun by @maria). Status: failed.

samir: Okay digging in locally — trying to reproduce with main + your branch. Can you paste the exact commit you rebased?

maria: branch head is 8f3b2a (feat/auth-normalize-headers). I rebased onto main @ 1768400000.

jen: Quick thought — we had a similar 500 in another project when header casing changes broke a simple dict lookup. Might be related to your normalization.

oliver: What's the failing test name again?

maria: tests/integration/test_session_flow.py::test_token_exchange (line ~213 in the file).

samir: Running bisect between main and 8f3b2a now.

samir: Found first bad commit: 8f3b2a — the header normalization change added in that commit drops header keys if they are None in incoming dict. Reproducer is simple:
```python
# reproducer snippet
headers = CaseInsensitiveDict(request.headers)
# earlier code did headers.get('authorization') safely, new code does headers['authorization']
```

samir: So the middleware now assumes 'authorization' always present after normalization; in the integration test the test harness injects headers with 'Authorization' (capital A) and the normalization path returned a dict missing the lowered key in this edge case.

maria: 🤦 that's my commit. I added an in-place normalization that returns a new mapping and I missed the get() usage. I can revert or patch right away.

kevin: Two options: quick revert to previous behavior (safe) or add a defensive .get('authorization') fallback. Revert is fastest to unblock CI.

maria: Pushed fix PR 678: revert the in-place normalizer and add fallback in validate_headers. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/678 — pinging @jen @oliver for fast review.

jen: Reviewing now. Small change, looks fine. 

oliver: LGTM, approve.

ci-bot: New build triggered for PR 678 (build 12347).

ci-bot: Build 12347 status: PASSED :tada:

maria: Thanks everyone — sorry for the churn. Will add an extra test for header casing and document the normalization behavior. :pray:

samir: Nice catch, thanks for the quick fix.

kevin: If you'd like I'll open a small follow-up to add the test so we don't regress.

maria: Please do, appreciate it!
